title: C–H olefination and nitrogen configurational interconversion
difficulty_reasons: Requires computed productive pathways for two nitrogen configurations with a common activation-energy reference.

Separately evaluates isolated S and P inversion using their own solvents, temperatures, minima and thermal corrections. Requires a bounded interpretation of enrichment and configurational stability without a complete dynamic kinetic resolution model.
